settings.title: Which Gymnastics Mats Offer the Most Support for Beginners and Advanced Athletes?

settings.text: When choosing gymnastics mats that provide support for both beginners and advanced athletes, a variety of options are available, each offering unique benefits based on the athlete's skill level and training needs.

settings.code:
1. 1-3/8" Cross Link Foam Mats – Ideal Thickness for Basic Tumbling and Safety

Best for Beginner-Level Gymnastics Training

The 1-3/8" Cross Link Foam Mats are perfect for beginners just starting out in gymnastics. These mats are lightweight, portable, and provide enough cushioning to protect against minor falls and impact during basic training. With a shock-absorbent foam core and durable vinyl surface, they help reduce injury risks while building core gymnastics skills.

Ideal Applications: Home use, beginner gymnastics, cheerleading, and basic tumbling.
Impact Absorption: Provides basic cushioning for safe practice.

Sports Examples:

  • Beginner Gymnastics
  • Cheerleading
  • Dance
  • Tumbling

2. 2" Cross Link Foam Mats – Extra Thickness for Enhanced Safety in Tumbling

Best for Intermediate to Advanced Gymnastics to High Impact Landings

The 2" Cross Link Foam Mats provide increased thickness and enhanced support, making them ideal for gymnasts who are advancing in skill. These mats are designed to absorb higher impact during advanced routines, including more challenging tumbling passes and flips. The firm yet flexible surface ensures stability and safety during intense training sessions.

Ideal Applications: Advanced gymnastics, tumbling, and cheerleading routines.
Impact Absorption: Superior protection for high-impact landings and advanced skills.

Sports Examples:

  • Intermediate to Advanced Gymnastics
  • Tumbling
  • Cheerleading

3. Combo Gymnastic Mats – Versatile Thickness and Comfortable for All Skill Levels

Best for Versatility and Skill Progression

The Combo Gymnastic Mats are designed with a dual foam core system that offers both firm and soft support, making them suitable for all levels of gymnastics training. These mats are highly versatile, providing comfort and protection whether you're practicing beginner routines or performing advanced flips. Their foldable and portable design makes them perfect for both home use and professional gyms.

Ideal Applications: General gymnastics, tumbling, cheerleading, and multi-sport use.
Impact Absorption: Excellent cushioning with added flexibility for any athlete.

Sports Examples:

  • Gymnastics (all levels)
  • Cheerleading
  • Tumbling

4. All-Purpose Tumbling Mats – Extra Protection for High-Impact Activities

Best for Multi-Sport Use and Gymnastics Safety

The All-Purpose Tumbling Mats offer a durable and highly protective surface for various sports activities. These foldable mats provide excellent impact absorption, making them ideal for gymnastics, tumbling, and other high-impact sports. The high-quality foam core ensures athletes are protected during landings and falls, while the lightweight design allows for easy transportation and storage.

Ideal Applications: Gymnastics, martial arts, cheerleading, tumbling, and general exercise.
Impact Absorption: Excellent for high-impact exercises, customizable thickness.

Sports Examples:

  • Gymnastics
  • Tumbling
  • Cheerleading
  • Martial Arts

5. Varsity Exercise Mats – High-Performance and Superior Thickness Support for Intense Training

Best for Advanced Gymnastics and Competitive Training

The Varsity Exercise Mats are built to withstand the demands of advanced gymnastics and high-level training. Their durable construction and shock-absorbing foam offer firm support for intense tumbling routines and advanced gymnastics maneuvers. These mats are ideal for gymnasts who require a reliable and portable surface for competitions or daily practice.

Ideal Applications: Competitive gymnastics, advanced tumbling, and high-performance training.
Impact Absorption: Designed for maximum protection during intense workouts.

Sports Examples:

  • Competitive Gymnastics
  • Tumbling
  • Advanced Cheerleading

settings.title: What Are the Key Features to Look for When Choosing Gymnastics Mats?

settings.text: Choosing the right gymnastics mat is crucial for ensuring both safety and performance during training. Whether you're selecting a mat for home practice, school gymnasiums, or professional gymnastic facilities, understanding the key features of gymnastics mats will help you make the best decision. Here are the most important factors to consider:

settings.title: Cross Link Foam Mats – Best for Striking and Ground-Based Martial Arts
settings.text:
Firm Support for Intense Workouts

Engineered to enhance stability and prevent heel digging, Cross Link Foam Mats provide an unparalleled level of firmness. This premium foam minimizes the risk of injuries, offering a stable surface that won't compress under pressure. Ideal for high-impact training, these mats are built to withstand intense movements like kicks, pivots, and sparring, making them a great choice for martial arts practitioners who need both support and protection.

1-3/8" Cross Link Foam Mats and 2" Cross Link Foam Mats:

settings.title: Combo Martial Arts Mats – Versatile Use in Martial Arts & Cheerleading
settings.text:
For athletes looking to practice a variety of moves with both support and shock absorption, the Combo Martial Arts Mats offer a dual foam core system. These mats combine the firmness of cross-link foam on top with the cushioning of rebond foam underneath, making them suitable for a range of martial arts that require both stability and protection from falls.

  • Ideal Applications: Martial arts training involving both striking and grappling, cheerleading stunts, and mixed athletic workouts.
  • Sports Examples: The dual-layer design of the Combo Martial Arts Mats is perfect for judo and Brazilian jiu-jitsu (BJJ), which require a safe landing surface for throws and falls, as well as for cheerleaders practicing jumps, tumbles, and stunts.

settings.title: Varsity Exercise Mats – Perfect for Tumbling, Physical Education, and General Exercise
settings.text:
For all-around use in gymnastics, physical education classes, and basic martial arts practice, Varsity Exercise Mats are a versatile choice.

  • Ideal Applications: School PE classes, tumbling practice, basic martial arts training, stretching, and dance routines.
  • Sports Examples: Varsity Exercise Mats are great for beginners in gymnastics to practice cartwheels and handstands, elementary school physical education sessions for general fitness activities, or even dance clubs for stretching and light movement routines.

settings.title: All Purpose Tumbling Mats – Best for High Impact and Tumbling Sports
settings.text:
If your training involves higher impact activities like tumbling, acrobatics, or throws, the All Purpose Tumbling Mats made with rebond foam are the way to go. The rebond foam, made from recycled foam pieces, offers excellent shock absorption, making these mats great for safely handling high-impact movements and falls.

  • Ideal Applications: High-impact martial arts (e.g., judo, aikido), gymnastics, acrobatics, and fitness routines with heavy tumbling.
  • Sports Examples: These mats are excellent for activities involving falls, rolls, and heavy impact. Whether you’re practicing aikido throws or gymnastics floor routines, the All Purpose Tumbling Mats provide the cushioning needed to absorb shocks and protect your joints.

settings.code:
1. Thickness and Impact Absorption

One of the most critical features of any gymnastics mat is its thickness, which directly affects impact absorption. Thicker mats, like the 2" Cross Link Foam Mats and the All-Purpose Tumbling Mats, provide superior cushioning, making them ideal for high-impact activities such as tumbling and advanced gymnastics. Thinner mats, like the 1-3/8" Cross Link Foam Mats, are better suited for beginner-level training or light gymnastics routines, where less cushioning is needed.

A thicker mat reduces the risk of injury by absorbing the impact from landings, flips, and falls. The right thickness depends on the intensity of your workouts—beginners can typically work with 1 3/8” thickness, while more advanced athletes may need the added support of 2” or more.

2. Material Durability

The material of the mat is another crucial factor to consider. High-quality mats, such as the Combo Gymnastic Mats and Varsity Exercise Mats, are constructed with durable, heavy-duty vinyl surfaces. These surfaces are designed to withstand rigorous use and are often antibacterial and antifungal, ensuring that the mat remains hygienic even with regular use.

Durable materials, especially reinforced vinyl, also protect against wear and tear, making them ideal for gymnasts who train intensively or for professional environments where mats see frequent use. A mat with a high-quality surface will last longer and provide better safety over time.

3. Portability and Storage

If you need mats that can be easily transported or stored, portability is key. Combo Gymnastic Mats and All-Purpose Tumbling Mats are foldable, making them easy to store when not in use. These mats are lightweight and designed for quick setup and takedown, which is ideal for home gyms, schools, and traveling teams.

Folding mats or mats with velcro strips for easy attachment are also great for expanding your practice space as needed. Look for mats that are easy to move but still provide the necessary support for your specific training level.

4. Shock Absorption and Stability

For advanced gymnasts, shock absorption is vital for safe practice. Mats like the Varsity Exercise Mats and 2" Cross Link Foam Mats are designed to offer firm support while absorbing the force of landings. These mats feature high-density foam cores that prevent the mat from shifting under pressure, ensuring stability during intense routines.

Mats that are too soft can lead to instability, while mats that are too firm may not provide adequate cushioning. The right balance of support and shock absorption ensures that athletes can practice complex moves safely and efficiently.

5. Size and Versatility

Depending on your training needs, mat size is another essential factor. Larger mats like the Combo Gymnastic Mats or All-Purpose Tumbling Mats offer more room for tumbling and gymnastics practice, which is great for both individual and team use. Mats that offer customizable sizing options, such as those with velcro strips to attach additional panels, allow for increased versatility.

When selecting a mat, consider the size of your training space and whether you need additional mats to create a larger surface. Portable mats that can be resized or adjusted are excellent for maximizing your practice area.

settings.title: What Thickness of Competition Landing Mats Is Ideal for Professional Gymnastics?

settings.text: When selecting the right landing mats for professional gymnastics, the thickness is a critical factor in ensuring athlete safety and performance. Whether you’re choosing Safety Cushions, Competition Landing Mats, or Throw Mats, understanding the best thickness for specific gymnastics routines can make all the difference. Here’s a breakdown of how each product contributes to safe landings and what thickness works best for professional use.

1. Safety Cushions – Available in 8" to 12" Thickness

Best for High Falls and Injury Prevention

Safety Cushions are specifically designed to offer maximum protection during training, particularly when gymnasts are practicing high falls or complex dismounts. These mats come in a variety of thicknesses, ranging from 8" to 12", with thicker options providing the most support for high-impact landings.

  • 8" to 12" Thickness: These deep-cushioned mats are ideal for cheerleading and gymnastics training, where safety is paramount. The honeycomb foam construction absorbs impact exceptionally well, ensuring that athletes can practice safely, even during higher-risk moves.

Safety Cushions are an essential addition to any professional gymnastics facility where injury prevention is a top priority.

Ideal Applications: Training for high-impact landings, cheerleading stunts, tumbling drills, and practicing falls.

2. Competition Landing Mats – Available in 12cm and 20cm Thickness

Best for Competitive Gymnastics and High-Impact Landings

The Competition Landing Mats are available in 12cm and 20cm thicknesses, designed to provide varying levels of support and cushioning for professional gymnastics.

  • 12cm Thickness: This option is ideal for controlled landings and moderate-impact routines. The thinner profile offers firm support while maintaining enough cushioning to reduce the risk of injury. It is commonly used in events like the balance beam or uneven bars, where precision and stability are essential.
  • 20cm Thickness: For higher-impact routines, such as dismounts, flips, and vaults, the 20cm thickness provides maximum cushioning and shock absorption. This thicker mat ensures gymnasts can land safely during intense routines, minimizing the chance of injury.

Ideal Applications: Balance beam, uneven bars, vaulting, and high-impact tumbling.

3. Throw Mats – Available in 4" to 12" Thickness

Best for Lightweight, Portable Protection in Various Sports

Throw Mats are available in a range of thicknesses, from 4" to 12", making them highly versatile for gymnastics, wrestling, martial arts, and more. These mats provide excellent impact absorption, and their lightweight design allows for easy portability, making them ideal for quick setup and repositioning in different training areas.

  • 4" to 12" Thickness: Thinner Throw Mats are best for basic tumbling or light exercises, while thicker versions (8" to 12") are great for absorbing shock during higher-impact landings. These mats are perfect for multi-sport training environments, offering safety without the bulk of permanent landing mats.

Throw Mats are a popular choice for schools, home gyms, and professional facilities where quick transitions between activities are common.

Ideal Applications: Multi-sport use, gymnastics, wrestling, martial arts, and tumbling drills.

settings.code:
What Are the Key Features to Look for in Mats for Big Falls and High-Impact Landings?

When it comes to preventing injuries from big falls, Safety Cushions, Competition Landing Mats, and Throw Mats all provide exceptional protection, each with specific advantages for different activities.

Safety Cushions are ideal for gymnastics and cheerleading, offering thick honeycomb foam or solid block foam for superior shock absorption. Available in multiple thicknesses (8", 10", and 12"), these cushions are designed to provide ultimate landing protection, minimizing the risk of injury during high falls. The 18 oz. vinyl surface ensures durability, and the antibacterial and antifungal coating keeps the mat hygienic.

For competitive gymnastics, Competition Landing Mats offer a perfect balance of firmness and flexibility with their combination of cross-link polyethylene and polyurethane foam. These mats provide excellent support for athletes during challenging maneuvers, while also cushioning big falls. Available in 12cm and 20cm thickness, they are the go-to option for gymnasts seeking both safety and performance.

Throw Mats are another excellent option, designed to offer exceptional landing protection with their solid block or honeycomb foam core. Available in various thicknesses (4", 6", 8", 10", and 12"), they are lightweight yet sturdy, making them easy to reposition for different training activities like gymnastics, wrestling, or karate.
